scoring_justification: The heat capacity is recomputed from the analytical g(ν) by numeric integration; the agent's values are compared to these references with a relative tolerance. Structural checks (monotonicity and Debye bound) provide additional physical plausibility.

outputs.description: Computed lattice heat capacity per mole divided by 3R at five low temperatures, demonstrating the intermediate position relative to Debye prediction and experimental data.

output_contract.notes: The low-frequency phonon spectrum g(ν) and Debye temperature are provided directly in the task instruction. The checker will recompute the reference C_v/3R values by integrating the same expression and compare the agent's values using a relative tolerance.
